lss.config.receive_server_lods.tooltip: Whether to receive LOD chunk data from the server. Disabling this stops all LOD networking.
lss.config.lod_distance.tooltip: Maximum LOD distance in chunks. Set to 0 to use the server's configured distance.
lss.config.column_rate_limit.tooltip: Caps how many LOD columns per second the server streams to you. Lower this if receiving LODs stutters your game or saturates your connection. Automatic backpressure still applies on top. Set to 0 for unlimited.
lss.config.far_players_enabled.tooltip: Show other players beyond normal render distance as simple player models in your LOD terrain. Only works on servers running LOD Server Support with far players enabled.
lss.config.far_players_share_self.toolti: Share your position with other players' LOD view. When enabled, players far away from you can see where you are (as a distant player model). Turn this off to stay invisible beyond normal render distance. Applies while connected through LOD Server Support (Receive Server LODs on, an LOD mod installed) — without that connection, only server-side settings (exclude list, permissions, vanish) protect your position. Server exclude lists and permissions always apply on top.
lss.config.far_players_name_tags.tooltip: Show name tags over far-player models.
lss.config.far_players_render_distance.t: Maximum distance (blocks) at which far players are drawn. Set this to roughly your fog distance if distant players fading at the horizon bothers you. 0 follows the server's limit.
